preserve: the command line of check.mjs: files, --reader, --owner, --kind, --artifact-kind, --stage, --plan, --context, --no-model, --decider, --json, --report, --quiet, with the same refusals
exit 0 passed, 1 failed, 2 unqualified, 3 uncertain; an input that produces no copy or has a reader issue makes the whole check unqualified and its report keeps none of its text
the report copy-check-report-v1: reader, owner, checker, rules and verdict rules with their BLAKE3, mode, coverage of every file with its source BLAKE3, results
a source is read only as a stable regular file within 8 MiB (readSourceBytes)
the reader-knowledge check over the reading units in order; when it cannot run every line holds reader-knowledge-not-run
questions go to a decider command and come back as one { option: p } or null each; --no-model never calls it and keeps every question unknown
allowed_deltas: the rules come from the person's branch of list:checks through the door (rulesOfBranch), never from copy-rules.json, ask-rules.json or verdict-rules.json
the layouts, spans, profiles, owners, fields, origin words and reader-knowledge rows come from the person's settings row (tools/settings readSettings)
the check is checkAFilmsCopy(input, door), the container row tool:check-a-films-copy; the command line is its computer run with --door-mcp or --door-records
the escalated lines are listed in the report for the person's verdict log instead of appended to a log file here
BLAKE3 from tools/content-identity instead of the b3sum program
banned_substitutions: a frozen copy of the person's rules in a file
a model called inside the tool
a write to the person's records or a log file
a pass on an unanswered question
